use_case_summary: Mid-market product search SaaS. Primary use-case is reranking search candidate sets returned by Elastic; goal is to increase top-3 relevance (CTR / conversion) while keeping per-request latency low. They need both offline scoring/eval (nightly re-evals) and an online rerank endpoint that accepts candidate-level features and returns ranked ids + scores. Started with Hosted API POC; intention to evaluate Dedicated for production due to data residency and predictable throughput.
poC_scope: Host a Hosted API POC: 10k online scored queries + offline batch scoring for 45k queries. Provide rerank endpoint integration examples, offline eval scripts, and candidate feature ingestion template. Deliver baseline metrics (MRR proxy, CTR@3, NDCG@5) and latency profile.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Hosted rerank endpoint p50 < 60ms on test pool of 500 queries. 2) Offline evaluation shows >=6% lift in CTR@3 vs current model or clear roadmap to achieve it. 3) Security questionnaire answered with SOC2 attestation and KMS support. 4) Pricing aligned with mid-market ARR target (75k-200k).
technical_constraints: Must accept candidate pools up to 200 items, per-call feature vectors (sparse + dense), support batching for throughput, and exportable eval metrics. Prefers AWS region us-east-1 for Hosted; Dedicated option must support VPC peering and customer KMS integration.
conversation_highlights: Product lead: 'we need a deterministic rollback if relevance degrades' — interested in canary/A-B rollout. CTO: 'show me offline reproducible evals first'. Procurement: 'need committed pricing tiers and SLA for Dedicated'.
procurement_notes: Procurement running vendor comparison with Elastic Cloud and Lucidworks. Key asks: enterprise contract length, termination clauses, and data residency commitments. Procurement expects final numbers by 2025-03-20.
competing_solutions_notes: They benchmarked against Elastic's learning-to-rank plugin and a smaller internal Lambda-based reranker. Redwood's differentiator is unified API + offline eval tooling and clear Dedicated pricing for predictable cost per QPS.
